commit.message:
Default Omni to r4 LTS and select startup from image tags (#87)

Default Spanner Omni to 2026.r4-lts and add the listen address needed for forwarded-port access. Select flagless startup automatically for image tags identifying 2026.r1 through 2026.r3, and expose --image in the CLI for selecting another version.

Retain the native image entrypoint and existing container customizer precedence. Document image-name matching, tagged digests and the experimental Omni compatibility boundary.

Validation: focused tests, full race tests, build, lint and whitespace checks passed locally. All four checks passed on ce27de80ed563db65447720d26cd9e588aaad195, including Docker and rootless Podman smoke coverage for r2.1, r3 and r4 LTS.

Update Emulator to 1.5.59 and Omni to 2026.r5

Update both default runtime images and align documentation, CLI help, and startup expectations. Local race, lint, build, Omni smoke including legacy images, and hosted build-and-test, lint, Docker Omni, and rootless Podman smoke checks passed.

@@ -76,7 +76,7 @@ database accumulation matters.
 
 ### Spanner Omni (experimental)
 
-Omni defaults to `2026.r4-lts`. Use `WithContainerImage(...)` to select another
+Omni defaults to `2026.r5`. Use `WithContainerImage(...)` to select another
 image. Startup automatically selects flagless arguments for tags containing
 2026.r1 through r3 and GA arguments for other references. See [package documentation](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/apstndb/spanemuboost#hdr-Omni_image_selection)
 for image selection and custom startup arguments.

@@ -66,7 +66,7 @@ Examples:
   spanemuboost stop --endpoint-file /tmp/omni-endpoint.json
   SPANEMUBOOST_ENDPOINT_FILE=/tmp/omni-endpoint.json go test ./...
 
-Omni defaults to 2026.r4-lts. Startup arguments are selected automatically:
+Omni defaults to 2026.r5. Startup arguments are selected automatically:
 tags containing 2026.r1 through r3 (or 2026-r1 through r3) omit the listen
 flag, including tagged digests. Other references use --listen-addresses=0.0.0.0.
 --image accepts --image value and --image=value.

+The Omni default is the Developer image `2026.r5`, with automatic startup
 selection from the image tag. Tags containing `2026.r1` through `2026.r3`
 (or `2026-r1` through `2026-r3`) use the flagless `start-single-server`
 command, regardless of the suffix. Version tokens are delimited so `r30` does
